message.content: Helios suggests several strategies for dealing with flying machines in "Horizon Forbidden West." He recommends using a bow equipped with elemental arrows to stun the flying machines, which makes them easier to take down. Additionally, Helios advises making use of the player's focus ability to track the movements of the flying machines, which helps in dodging their attacks. Another effective tactic mentioned is setting up traps, which can be particularly useful in combat situations. These strategies help in managing encounters with the flying machines effectively within the game.
